title: Cosmic Eye in Desert
description: A surreal desert landscape features a massive fiery orange eye with a black pupil at the center of a chaotic cosmic explosion. To its right floats a large dripping orb covered in vibrant rainbow paint, surrounded by colorful translucent bubbles, comets, and a distant mesa under a purple sky.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at dusk with a giant fiery orange and black cosmic eye exploding with dark energy and lava-like cracks on the left side. A large glossy sphere covered in dripping vibrant rainbow paint floats in the center. Colorful translucent bubbles, shooting stars, and orbs float throughout the scene with distant red mesas and saguaro cacti in the background under a purple sky, highly detailed surreal painting style.
